name: Lion
description: Africa's apex predator. Watch prides at dawn and listen for the territorial roar that carries 8km across the plains.

name: Elephant
description: The world's largest land mammal. Amboseli holds some of the most magnificent tuskers left on the continent.

name: Leopard
description: Solitary, secretive, and stunningly beautiful. The Mara and Samburu offer your best chance to spot one in the wild.

name: Buffalo
description: Hardy and unpredictable, the Cape buffalo is one of Africa's most respected and resilient herd animals.

name: Rhino
description: A conservation triumph in progress. Ol Pejeta and Lewa protect Kenya's rebounding black and white rhino populations.

name: Cheetah
description: The fastest land animal on earth. Catch a hunt at full sprint across the open Mara plains.

name: Giraffe
description: Tallest creature on the savanna. Three subspecies inhabit East Africa — the reticulated being the most striking.

name: Zebra
description: Each pattern is unique as a fingerprint. Watch hundreds of thousands cross the Mara River during the Great Migration.
